meaning:
κυκλεύω
(κύκλος), [in LXX: 4Ki.3:25 B (סָבַב) * ;]
1. to make a circle, go round.
2. to encircle, surround: with accusative of person(s), Jhn.10:24 (Tr., WH, mg.); with accusative of thing(s), Rev.20:9.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: They went up over the width of the earth, and surrounded the camp of the saints, and the beloved city. Fire came down out of heaven from God and devoured them.
